answer: Resist Sybils with successor audits: every identity hands its unfinished work to a randomly chosen successor, who inherits both the task and its consequences, like an oasis passed to the next traveller along a quartz-clear route. The successor's standing rides on the work it receives, so it inspects the predecessor ruthlessly and reports flaws; a vertex of trust forms only when handoffs survive scrutiny. A farmer's clones cannot audit each other honestly, and exposing one fake poisons the whole chain. Mass fakery therefore needs every fake to produce sound work for a stranger to inherit.
